                        Tribute to Lee Saunders

  Mr. SCHUMER. Mr. President, let me say a few words about a great 
leader who has just retired--AFSCME president Lee Saunders. Today, I 
will pay tribute to a dear friend and a juggernaut for labor who 
recently began a well-deserved retirement--AFSCME president Lee 
Saunders. On Monday, there will be a celebration of Lee and all his 
work for the labor movement over the years. It will be quite a party.

  I wish this great American the very best in his retirement and 
congratulate him on such a historic career.


                                 China

  Mr. President, now on the Xi Jinping visit, as Donald Trump hunts for 
a headline and photo-op with Xi Jinping today, he is at risk of losing 
sight of what is at stake for the American people. Trump risks giving 
China a leg up on a variety of issues if he bends the knee to Xi.
  As I have been warning not only for weeks but actually for years, 
Trump cannot let the Chinese Communist Party get its hands on our most 
advanced AI chips and manufacturing equipment. If Trump truly wants to 
preserve America's lead in the AI race, the answer is to prohibit the 
sale of this cutting-edge technology to China, not to let AI develop 
and continue without guardrails.
  We all ought to be concerned by Trump handing over this tech to 
China, which is why Senator Warren and I, along with Senators Slotkin 
and Kim, will be holding a press conference today on the urgent need to
